en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 1. It was narrated to me by Muhammad b. al-Hassan who said it was narrated to me by Muhammad b. al-Hassan al-Saffar from Muhammad b. Isa from Abbas b. Hilal al-Shami from Abi al-Hassan al-Ridha from his father (a.s.)
who said: Imam Ridha (a.s.) narrates from his predecessors that one who recites the following verse before going to bed,
his house will never be damaged: Innallaaha yumassikus samaawaati wal arz”a antazoolaa wala-in zaalataa in amsakahumaa min ah’adim mim ba’dihi innahu kaanaa h’aleeman ghafooraa.”
